title: Area of a Circle: Formula, Why It Is πr², 22/7 vs 3.14 and Worked Examples
seoTitle: Area of a Circle: Formula, Derivation and Examples
seoDescription: Area of a circle = πr². Find it from the radius, diameter or circumference, see why 22/7 and 3.14 differ by under 0.1%, and solve sector and ring sums.
excerpt: Five solved sums, from a rangoli and a village well to a ring-shaped path costed in rupees, plus the slicing proof, how much 22/7 and 3.14 really differ, pizza-size maths and where circles sit in the new NCERT books.
